description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

State Farm is hiring a Software Engineer for its Availability Assurance Technical Triage team. The role combines software development and application modernization with availability triage, outage investigation, and efforts to improve system resiliency.
Availability Engineering Software Engineer developing and modernizing full-stack Availability Assurance applications on ROSA/OpenShift, improving reliability.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend, frontend, and full-stack features for PDT and other Availability Assurance applications
• Design, implement, and support application modernization efforts, including migrating containerized workloads to cloud-native platforms such as ROSA/OpenShift
• Support applications throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and implementation through monitoring and continuous improvement
• Collaborate with engineers, product partners, and quality teams to deliver reliable, user-focused solutions
• Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews and testing practices
• Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and observability of existing services
• Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to long-term resiliency improvements
• Participate in technical triage efforts, including Availability Assurance Bridge activities
• Investigate application outages and service disruptions, identify root causes, and recommend recovery actions
• Partner with support and engineering teams to improve application and infrastructure resiliency
• Contribute to architecture discussions, technical planning, and operational excellence initiatives

Requirements:
• Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B visa) for this opportunity
• Experience developing and supporting software applications using JavaScript for frontend and backend development
• Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, testing practices, containers, and secure coding principles
• Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
• Ability to learn and adapt solutions to align with enterprise architecture and technology standards related to modernization efforts
• Working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure platforms and security principles, including technologies such as ROSA, WAS, CaaS, AWS, Azure, Load Balancing, LDAP, and Proxy services
• Experience using monitoring and diagnostic tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Elasticsearch, and Grafana
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose complex application and infrastructure issues
• Strong collaboration and communication skills
• Self-motivated with the ability to identify issues and influence teams toward resilient solutions
• Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies
• Ability to balance software engineering responsibilities with operational and availability-focused work

Preferred:
• Experience with distributed systems, resiliency engineering, or site reliability practices
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices
• Knowledge of Linux, containers, cloud-native technologies, and enterprise application platforms
• Experience supporting production applications in a large-scale environment
